m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Here I sit, trying to run a legitimate business and everyone gives me trouble. I built this bridge! So what if I tore down the old one!
No one gets across my bridge today. No one. If you've got a complaint, by all means, come a little closer. I dare you.
Hey, hey, now. You've made your point. I'll move on. Another day, another bridge. So it goes.
There is lever. Pull that and it will lower bridge. Then we are on our way, comrade. No more delays.
Now we cross bridge and look for Mariya's sister, Zoya. Ivan has met her before. Zoya knows Forlorn Tayg like back of her paw.
She will guide you to Baba Yaga's house. Ivan must attend to other matters. I hope you understand, comrade. This was not Ivan's intent.
You heard about trouble in Urville Station, yes? Ivan has... history there. If Pingouins of Urville are in danger, he must go.
We will not part ways just yet, though. Let us find Zoya first.
You're the first ones I've seen come across that bridge in some time. Does that mean someone taught Dyomo a lesson? Good. Glad to hear it.
Baba Yaga? You people are truly mad, aren't you? Listen. If you're determined, you'll just have to deal with Dyomo the Bridgebuilder.
Dyomo and his Tundra Trolls like to tear down bridges. Then they build new ones and charge travelers a toll to get across.
That's what they've done just with the New Blago Bridge. If you want to cross, you'll have to get Dyomo to raise the bridge.  Good luck.
Can't believe I'm saying this, but if you make it across, look for my sister Zoya. She can point you in the direction of Baba Yaga's house.
If you're going to confront Dyomo, be careful. There's no nastier troll this side of Oskutsk. Don't say I didn't warn you.
